coordinator.const: authenticated runtime to durable cutex_session to current logical seat occupant

terminal_authority.const: authenticated runtime to durable cutex_session to current completion-policy seat occupant

worker.const: POST /api/task/v2/worker-prepare; cutex/task-service-worker-prepare/v2 semantic probe followed by POST /api/task/v2/actions; cutex/task-service-worker-provider/v2 durable prepared envelope wrapping an unchanged cutex/task-service-action/v2 document

query.const: POST /api/task/v2/query; cutex/task-service-query/v2; legacy authenticated POST /api/task/v2/worker-context remains diagnostic only

store.const: separate durable cutex/seat-occupancy-store/v1 with monotonic seat epoch

administration.const: Management-authenticated POST/GET /v2/task-service/seats using a route-scoped credential derived from an explicit Management token distinct from Agent Bus

agent_bus_bearer.const: cannot bind, rebind or claim seat authority

worker_envelope.const: cutex/task-service-worker-provider/v2: {schema, action, context}; action is the byte-compatible semantic Worker document

worker_prepare.const: cutex/task-service-worker-prepare/v2 accepts only the unchanged semantic Worker action; durable response is either the original committed receipt or a provider-resolved cutex/task-service-worker-provider/v2 envelope

attempt_binding.const: provider durably binds attempt_number + attempt_token; expected_attempt_revision is a refreshable prepared CAS precondition for report_status, block, resume, submit and abort_attempt

assignment_cas.const: provider prepares expected_assignment_revision for every Worker operation; start and decline have durable attempt_binding=null

create_revision.const: expected_workflow_revision=null for a new workflow, exact current workflow revision otherwise

retry_delivery.const: expected_assignment_revision; new SendAttempt has no prior revision

cancel_assignment.const: expected_assignment_revision; exact active attempt binding when one exists

cancel.const: expected_assignment_revision; exact active attempt binding when one exists

send_attempt_cas.const: Task Service system communication events carry expected_send_attempt_revision

assignment_contract_delivery.const: new protected assignment messages carry the exact committed task revision opaque_contract and contract_sha256; sender, queue and receiver verify SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 bytes; the human summary is separate and never substitutes for or duplicates the contract; legacy committed messages without opaque_contract remain readable; transport maximum is 262144 bytes with no truncation, and recovery is a new smaller task revision

completion_notification_outbox.const: semantic transitions atomically persist stable assignment+attempt+task-revision+action correlated intentions; authenticated Task Service system delivery records queued, delivered or uncertain facts without changing task completion

worker_followup_outbox.const: request_changes atomically persists one exact-assignee durable-session follow-up; authenticated Task Service Soon delivery records queued, delivered or uncertain facts and requires native context insertion before Agent Bus acknowledgement

stable_digest.const: authenticated action ID + semantic request + durable original attempt binding where applicable; excludes every expected aggregate revision, journal sequence, runtime occurrence and session-store revision for Worker, coordinator, terminal and system-send actions

durable_preparation.const: journaled prepared_worker_actions keyed by action ID survive provider reopen; same semantic action may refresh CAS only while assignment and attempt identity remain unchanged and legal; successful execution collapses preparation into its durable receipt

replay_order.const: authenticated action-ID plus semantic request probes durable receipt first and returns the original committed receipt before state, handle or CAS evaluation; changed semantic content conflicts; execute consumes only mechanics matching the provider-persisted preparation

query_secrecy.const: ordinary assignee query is filtered and redacted; Worker prepare returns mechanics only to the authenticated durable assignee; seated query remains the trusted coordinator/terminal mechanical source

mechanical_fields.const: attempt_token, attempt_number and aggregate-local expected revisions exist only in trusted context/provider envelopes and never in assignment messages, prompt/model input, semantic Worker schema or compact model output
